# MCPJam native execution receipts

Captured 2026-10-25 from real local executors. The upstream model was **scripted**, using MCPJam's official conformance servers; these are not authenticated model or hosted-account acceptance results. Files were actually written/read by the unmodified vendor runtimes, and denied/invalid edits were actually rejected. Full isolated runs and source hashes are recorded in `SUPPORT_MCPJAM_LIVE.md`.

- `codex-receipts.jsonl`: the six original `response_item` custom-tool call/result lines from Codex 0.149.1 through MCPJam's official app-server bridge at `c6c376ef07d5edf68d5f26775952def18b98cebe`. Successful creation, approval denial, and invalid edit. SHA-256 `65da87a36d8476f53ae872e9baa5e5daa95ce19e0a2d87f21a3c6e1b8ae79ba0`.
- `claude-receipts.jsonl`: the six original assistant/user tool call/result lines from `@ai-sdk/harness-claude-code@1.0.121` and `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.245`, as used by MCPJam. Successful Write, denied Write, and Read. SHA-256 `843dd7565a7c05e8e321b254e500825b9d6c0aaf0846da0f0329104c81511ce4`.
- `codex-background.jsonl`: ten unchanged `response_item` lines captured on 2026-10-26 from Codex 0.164.0 through MCPJam's official command translation and bridge. Includes a delayed write completed by an empty `write_stdin` poll, a delayed write exiting 9, and a write with no final process receipt. SHA-256 `5109c49f529f9af7b90bc74cd45dca16fec445df4e759c1c30aaa51ec8832d2d`. The latter two files really existed on disk; neither is successful execution evidence.

These lines are unchanged; other context rows are omitted. Integration tests explicitly bind the recorded temporary paths to a new test workspace and construct their own session header where required. The model names in these receipts are identifiers supplied by the test upstream, not evidence that a commercial model was contacted.

Sources: [MCPJam bridge](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/tree/c6c376ef07d5edf68d5f26775952def18b98cebe/mcpjam-inspector/server/utils/harness/codex-appserver), [scripted Responses server](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/blob/c6c376ef07d5edf68d5f26775952def18b98cebe/.spike-codex-appserver/probe/fake-responses-server.mjs), [scripted Anthropic server](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/blob/c6c376ef07d5edf68d5f26775952def18b98cebe/mcpjam-inspector/server/utils/harness/local/conformance/mock-anthropic.mjs).

The repeatable live runner is [`live/mcpjam.mjs`](../../live/mcpjam.mjs). It builds the upstream modules without editing them, includes the official loopback launcher, uses fresh isolated roots, and asserts real file writes, native history, Creditia attribution and unchanged source files. See `SUPPORT_MCPJAM_LIVE.md` for prerequisites, invocation and the unattended Bash boundary.
